question: Aajeevika - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India in the year _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3,

The correct answer is __**2011**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Aajeevika - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India, in **June 2011**.
 
• NRLM aims at reducing poverty by enabling the rural poor to engage in sustainable livelihood opportunities through self-help groups (SHGs).
 
• It was designed as a successor to the Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) with a broader focus on livelihood enhancement.
 
• The mission is funded in partnership between the Government of India and the World Bank.
 
• NRLM operates on the principle of **community-driven development**, empowering women and marginalized groups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs):**

 
 
• SHGs are the backbone of NRLM and consist of 10-20 members who come together to save and improve their financial status.
 
• They also receive training for capacity building, financial literacy, and entrepreneurial skills.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of NRLM:**
 
 
• Focus on women empowerment, with 70% of SHGs comprising women.
 
• Access to credit, skill-building, and market linkages for livelihood enhancement.
 
• Encouragement of sustainable development practices.
 
 
 
• **World Bank Partnership:**
 
 
• The World Bank supports NRLM through financial aid and technical assistance.
 
• It emphasizes community-based institutions for implementation.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Livelihoods:**
 
 
• NRLM promotes agriculture, animal husbandry, handicrafts, and other sustainable livelihoods.
 
• It aims to ensure that the rural poor achieve significant economic independence.
